application_fee: A non-refundable fee of Rs 500 is mandatory for applicants other than Ex-Servicemen, SC, ST, Women, and PwBD candidates, who are exempted from the fee. || The fee must be deposited online throughState Bank Collect (SBI Collect)only; fees paid through any other mode will not be accepted, and the application will be treated as without fee and rejected. || The transaction number/receipt number generated after successful payment must be mentioned at the appropriate place in the online application before submission. || Candidates must download the e-receipt from SBI Collect and upload it in the online application, and are advised to preserve it for future reference. || A candidate can apply for multiple post codes subject to fulfilling eligibility criteria for each; primary/registration details need to be submitted only once, but the application form (except registration details) must be filled and the fee paid separately for each post code. || Fee once paid will not be refunded on any count, and the application once finally submitted cannot be withdrawn or modified.
selection_process: Selection is a three-stage process: screening of applications, a qualifying Trade Test, and a Competitive Written Examination. This section explains the marking scheme and qualifying criteria for the written stage. || Online applications received within the stipulated last date are screened by a duly constituted Screening Committee, which shortlists candidates for a Trade Test in the relevant trade. The Trade Test isqualifying in nature; its syllabus will be notified separately on the official website. || Candidates who qualify in the Trade Test are called for the Competitive Written Examination.
